headline: News Headline 1
summary: As of market close on August 22, 2027, the Zenith Growth Fund reported a Net Asset Value (NAV) of $12.57 per unit based on current market prices and $14.82 per unit based on cost

headline: News Headline 2
summary: At the end of trading on April 30, 2026, the Zenith Growth Fund reported a Net Asset Value (NAV) of $12.50 per unit based on current market prices and $13.75 per unit based on cost.

headline: News Headline 3
summary: Following the quarterly review on March 15, 2026, the Fund announced a dividend payout ratio of 5% for its unit holders.

headline: News Headline 4
summary: As of April 30, 2026, the Fund's total assets under management reached Tk. 1 billion, reflecting a steady growth trajectory.

headline: News Headline 5
summary: In an effort to enhance transparency, the Fund will begin publishing monthly performance reports starting May 2026.

headline: News Headline 6
summary: The Fund's management team will hold a webinar on June 20, 2026, to discuss investment strategies and market outlook.

headline: News Headline 7
summary: On July 1, 2026, the Fund will implement a new fee structure aimed at reducing costs for small investors.
